result.summary: The page layout is generally sound, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure that makes its main message nearly illegible, plus a couple of minor styling inconsistencies in the cards.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtitle 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white/near-white text on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast and text that is barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark green or near-black (or darken the banner background) so the text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button treatment across all cards (e.g. semi-transparent dark circle with white heart) for visual consistency.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light grey background while neighbouring thumbnails use dark imagery, so the white duration pill ('15–25 min') sits on a light background and loses definition.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow/border to the duration pill or apply a consistent image overlay gradient so pills remain legible on light thumbnails.
